english: Anti-ship Warfare consists of all weapons used offensively against other ships, but does not include missiles.  Efficiency rating is based on a combination of accuracy and damage done compared to damage potential for all shots fired.
chinese: "反舰作战" 是指所有用于攻击敌方舰船的武器，但不包含导弹。其评分是将攻击的 "实际精度" 结合 "造成伤害" 与 "伤害潜力" 对比的结果。

english: Missile Defense considers the effectiveness of all anti-missile systems including point defense turrets, interceptor missiles, and electronic countermeasures.  Efficiency is evaluated based on the number of missiles determined to be threatening the ship compares to how many were defeated.
chinese: "导弹防御" 是指有效运用点防御炮塔、拦截弹、电子反制等反导弹系统。其评分是 "造成威胁的导弹数量" 与 "实际拦截的导弹数量" 对比的结果。

english: Engineering and Mobility considers resource generation and consumption, damage control, and resilience.  Efficiency is evaluated based on resource demand compared to availability, time spent immobilized, damage repaired, and the number of critical components restored.
chinese: "轮机" 与 "移动力" 是指资源生产/消耗、损害管制、韧性等。其评分是根据 "资源需求/供给量" 、 "无法移动的时间"、 "修复的损伤"、 "修复的重要零件数量" 等指标判定。

english: Missile Warfare consists of all offensive missile weapons used against enemy ships.  Efficiency is evaluated based on hits vs misses/defeats and total damage done compared to damage potential, weighted more heavily towards hits.
chinese: "导弹作战" 是指所有用于攻击敌方舰船的导弹武器。其评分是将 "实际命中"、"未命中/遭击败" 及 "总伤害量" 对比的结果，命中数占有的评分权重较高。

english: Sensor Warfare encompasses the effective use of all on-board sensor suites and electronic protection measures.  Efficiency is based solely on "stealth efficiency", which is a ratio of the time spent holding enemy tracks while remaining unseen by the enemy.
chinese: "传感器作战" 是指有效运用所有舰载传感器套件与电子防护手段。其评分仅根据 "匿踪效率" 判定。"匿踪效率" 指的是在维持自身隐匿的情况下，持续追踪敌方目标的时间。

english: Strike Warfare consists of all weapons used offensively by spacecraft against warships.  Efficiency rating is based on a combination of accuracy and damage done compared to damage potential for all shots fired.
chinese: "打击作战" 是指战机用于反舰作战的所有武器。其评分是将攻击的 "实际精度" 结合 "造成伤害" 与 "伤害潜力" 对比的结果。

english: Void Superiority measures how effective spacecraft were in engaging and destroying enemy spacecraft in defense of the fleet.  Efficiency is evaluated based on enemy craft destroyed vs friendly craft lost in each recorded engagement, combined with the accuracy of weapons.
chinese: "空优" 是指我方战机打击敌方舰队防御战机的效率。其评分是对比每场战斗的 "敌方战机击毁数" 及 "我方战机损失数" ，并结合 "武器精度" 数据后判定的结果。

Enable/Disable Recording

english:
The condition under which this unit will pursue the player's fleet when it leaves the room.  This only applies if the ship is active in the room and not eliminated.

NEVER: Never pursue the player's fleet and remain in this room.
ALWAYS: Always pursue, regardless of destination.
VAR: Pursue when the selected boolean variable is true.
DEST: Pursue when the player's fleet has departed for this destination only (for multi-destination, use an event script triggered on departure, and set a VAR based on the destination rooms).
chinese:
该单位在玩家舰队离开区域时展开追击的条件，只有舰船在该区域内活动且并未被歼灭时才适用。 

从不：不会追击玩家的舰队并停留在该区域。 
总是：不论目的为何皆进行追击。 
变数：Boolean 变数条件成立时进行追击。 
目的：只有在玩家舰队前往此目的地时追击（若有多个目的地，则在离开时触发事件脚本，并根据目的区域设置变数）。

english: In addition to the 'Pursue When...' condition, ships can decide to pursue the player based on their condition.  By default ships set to pursue will always pursue, but sometimes you may want the ship to pursue only when it actually has offensive weapons or some other condition.
chinese: 除 "追击时机..." 条件外，舰船可以根据自身状况追击玩家。预设情况下，已设置追击的舰船才会进行追击，但有时你可能会希望只有在舰船拥有攻击武器或满足特定条件才进行追击。

english: A hull's integrity directly affects how safe its components are from damage.  Lots of empty space means less structural members to absorb damage and protect mounts, compartments, and modules.  A ship with the majority of its component slots filled will have the full protection of the hull's Damage Reduction (DR) value, while a mostly empty hull will not.
chinese: 舰体强度将直接影响零件受损的机率，过多的空置空间代表结构中可用于保护基座、舱间、模组的缓冲较少。将舰船主要零件栏位填满便可拥有最佳的伤害减低（DR）数值，反之则无法获得完整数值保护。

english: This fleet must be saved before it can be taken to the testing range.
chinese: 必须先保存此舰队才能于试验场使用。

english: The weapons on this ship have more than one different type of ammunition available to them, but the ship is only carrying one type.  Bringing a wide set of ammunition types can greatly increase versatility.
chinese: 此舰船上的武器可使用多种类型弹药，但目前仅携带一种。携带各型弹药可大幅增加运用弹性。

english: This ship has 6 or more modifiers applied to the same stat.  Stat modifiers experience diminishing returns and using different modules to improve a more broad set of stats may boost general capability more cost-effectively.
chinese: 有 6 个（含）以上的修正项套用在此艘舰船的同一数值。数值修正项有增益递减的问题，使用不同模块提升综合数值是成本效益较高的办法。

english: The Keystone destroyer hull is designed around a spinal mount which can carry unique weapons.  It is recommended to use one of these weapons to take maximum advantage of the hull.
chinese: 拱心石驱逐舰体以脊型基座为框架打造，能够安装特殊武器。推荐安装一种特殊武器来完全发挥舰体的优势。

english: While not required for every ship, having damage control can greatly improve ship resiliency.  Without it, a single fire can eventually burn down the whole ship.  Damage control is recommend for most ships, and larger ships should carry proportionally more damage control lockers.
chinese: 并非每艘船都需要，但拥有损害管制能大幅提高生存性。有时只要一场火灾，就可能摧毁整艘船。建议为大部分舰船配备损害管制，且损管机柜数量应随着舰船规模增加。

english: This ship does not have any dedicated point defense weapons.  While not required for every ship, especially if they intend to operate in a group supported by other ships, not having them will leave the ship very vulnerable to missiles.
chinese: 此舰船未安装专用点防御武器。若有舰队支援，则非每艘船都需要点防御武器，但缺少支援时这些舰船将变得相当脆弱。

english: This ship is not equipped with a general purpose search sensor.  Some specialized ships forego having their own organic sensors, but doing so leaves them completely reliant on other ships for target acquisition.  If the communications antenna is lost this ship can be rendered blind to anything beyond visual range.
chinese: 此舰船未配备通用搜索传感器。部分特殊舰船会选择放弃原先的感测系统，完全仰赖其他舰船进行目标获取。若通讯天线被毁，这艘船就无法观测目视距离外的目标。

english: Some offensive weapons on this ship have enough ammunition for more than 60 minutes of continuous firing time across all ammo types.  Most battles last less than 60 minutes, and not all time is spent continuously firing.
chinese: 装载弹药量可供进攻武器持续发射各型弹药超过 60 分钟。多数战斗皆会在 60 分钟内结束，而且也不会将所有时间耗费在开火上。

english: The ammunition quantity available for some point defense weapons exceeds 5 minutes of continuous firing.  It is unlikely that they would be firing continuously for more than that time, and those points could be saved for use elsewhere.
chinese: 装载弹药量可供点防御武器持续开火超过 5 分钟。因为不会长时间射击，这些资源可待后续使用。

english: This ship's power budget is tight and demand may exceed availability at times.  Exceeding power limits is OK, as not all systems operate continuously, but you should be mindful of situations in which many systems will be operating simultaneously.
chinese: 舰船的电力有限，需求偶尔会超过发电量。并非所有系统都需持续运作，因此超出动力上限不会造成问题，但须格外注意多项设备同时运作的状况。

english: This ship is carrying two search sensors of the same type, and only one will operate at any given time. While this does provide some basic redundancy if one is destroyed, you can gain additional capability and redundancy by choosing a sensor of a different type.
chinese: 此舰船配备了两部相同的搜索传感器，而每次只能使用一部传感器。这种配置能防止一部传感器损坏就完全丧失搜索能力，但也能安装不同类型的传感器来获得额外能力与冗余。

english: The {className} hull has a major strength in its ability to use equipment from the {factionName} faction in addition to the equipment of its own faction.
chinese: {className}舰体的强项是，不仅能使用所属阵营装备，也能使用{factionName}阵营的装备。

english: This ship is carrying a large number of spacecraft, but does not have any modules which improve its throughput.  Increasing sortie preparation speed and deck throughput can greatly increase the impact of your carrier on the battle.
chinese: 此艘航母携带大量战机，但并未配备能提升流通量的模块。只要提高出击准备速度与甲板流通量，航母就能在战场上发挥影响力。

english: This ship is an expensive and/or heavy asset, and its survivability in combat would be greatly improved by using a Reinforced CIC.
chinese: 此艘舰船可能为高价值资产或重型单位，使用强化型战情室可大幅提高生存性。

english: This hull can be equipped with a Citadel Magazine, Damage Control Complex, or Large DC Storage in its extra-large compartments.  These are powerful faction-specific compartments which greatly improve survivability.
chinese: 此舰体可配备堡垒弹舱、损害管制区，或于大型船舱中安装损害管制仓储。这些功能强大的阵营专属舱间可大幅提升舰船生存性。

english: Fleet has unsaved changes.  Are you sure you want to {actionName}?
chinese: 舰队有未保存的变更。确定要{actionName}？

english: The automatic fleet upgrade tool was unable to upgrade this fleet to be compatible with the latest version of the fleet editor.  Please select another fleet.
chinese: 自动升级工具无法升级此舰队，因此无法与最新版舰队编辑器兼容。请选择其他舰队。

english: One or more of the loadouts for a craft design in this fleet uses munition types which are no longer compatible with this craft.  It is highly recommended to edit this fleet and adjust loadouts before taking it into battle.
chinese: 此舰队中某艘战机的一个或多个弹药挂载使用了不兼容的弹药类型，建议先调整舰队与挂载再开始战斗。

english: {shipName} does not have enough crew to operate all systems
chinese: {shipName}船员不足，无法操作所有系统。

english: {shipName} does not have enough of the resource {resourceName} to provide for the basic requirements of all systems which draw the resource continuously.
chinese: {shipName}的{resourceName}资源不足，无法满足所有系统的基础消耗。

english: The missile launcher {compName} on {socketName} contains invalid munition designs.
chinese: {compName}上的{socketName}导弹发射器装有无效弹药设计。

english: {shipName} does not have enough of the resource {resourceName} to simultaneously operate all systems which draw the resource only when operating.
chinese: {shipName}的{resourceName}资源不足，无法同时操作启用时需消耗资源的系统。

english: The weapon {compName} on {socketName} has no ammunition available on the ship.
chinese: 舰船未装载{compName}上的{socketName}武器可用的弹药。

english: {shipName} has no command compartment (e.g. CIC) installed.  The ship cannot be controlled and will be abandoned immediately after battle starts.
chinese: {shipName}未安装指挥舱（战情室）。此舰船无法操控，将于战斗开始后立即抛弃。

english: {shipName} has no drives installed and will be immobile.
{shipName} is not carrying enough ammunition for at least one loadout used by {craftName}
chinese: {shipName}携带弹药不足，无法满足{craftName}至少单次挂载的使用量。

english: The missile launcher {compName} on {socketName} has no missiles loaded.
chinese: {compName}上的{socketName}导弹发射器未装填导弹。

english: The weapon {compName} on {socketName} has only one round of the ammunition type {ammoName} available.  Did you forget to add more?
chinese: {compName}上的{socketName}武器仅有一发弹药{ammoName}可用。忘记补充了吗？

english: {shipName} has one or more weapons which are not assigned to groups.
The magazine in {socketName} contains the ammunition type {ammoName} which is not used by any weapons.
chinese: {socketName}的弹舱含有弹药类型{ammoName}，无任何武器使用。

english: None of the stat buffs provided by the {compName} on socket {socketName} are benefitting the systems currently installed on the ship.
chinese: 插口{compName}的{socketName}无提供任何加成，舰船上的系统并未获益。

Some mods in the active list are missing dependencies.  Would you like to automatically download and/or add these dependencies to the list? You will be prompted before downloading any mods you are not currently subscribed to.

Cancel will auto-sort the currently active list only.
chinese:
启用列表中的部分模组缺少依赖项。是否要自动下载并加入列表？下载未订阅的模组前会收到提示。

若按下取消，则仅会自动整理启用列表。

english: Base version of the game, including all hulls, weapons, effects, etc.  Cannot be deactivated.
chinese: 原始版本的游戏，包含所有舰体、武器、效果等。无法关闭。

english:
You are not currently subscribed to the following mods which are in use by one or more players.  Would you like to subscribe and download now?  If you choose Cancel, required mods which you have subscribed to previously will still be loaded.

<color=red>Only subscribe to mods that you trust.  Click on a mod below to visit its Steam Workshop page.
chinese:
尚未订阅许多玩家也在使用的以下模组。是否要立即订阅并下载？若选择取消，先前订阅的必要模组依然会加载。

<color=red>请保持谨慎并订阅可信任的模组。点击下方任意模组前往 Steam 创意工坊页面。

chinese:
缺少依賴項

chinese: 警告：作者尚未验证此模组能在目前游戏版本运作

english: Not enough votes to report Stars
Changes to the active mod list have been applied.  The game will now restart.
chinese: 启用模组列表变更已应用，游戏将重新启动。

Press 'Accept' to continue at your own risk, or 'Cancel' to automatically remove out-of-date mods and apply the changes.
chinese: 部份所选模组尚未与此版本游戏进行验证。模组可能导致各种意外，使用旧版模组更是如此。点击 "接受" 代表你愿意继续并承担风险；点击 "取消" 则会自动移除所有旧版模组并应用该变更。

The host of this lobby has marked it as mod friendly.  If you would like to play with modded fleets, this is a good place to do it.

(Note that some mods may not be acceptable to all players, even in mod friendly lobbies.)
chinese:
拥有者标示此服务器为模组友善。若想使用带有模组的舰队，此处很适合你。

（注意，即便是模组友善，部分模组也可能不被其他人接受）

取消刷新 找到

english: This server has autobalance enabled.  Players may vote to automatically balance teams by rank.  Some servers may have team autobalance triggered by severe rank discrepancy automatically.
chinese: 此服务器已开启自动平衡，玩家能投票并根据阶级自动平衡队伍。部分服务器会因阶级严重不均而自动触发自动平衡机制。

english: This server is a ranked and/or competitive server.  Data may be collected by the server owner in order to calculate ranks.
chinese: 此服务器有排名且/或竞争激烈。服务器拥有者可能会收集你的数据以计算排名。

english: The host of this lobby has marked it as mod friendly.  If you would like to play with modded fleets, this is a good place to do it.
chinese: 拥有者标示此服务器为模组友善。若想使用带有模组的舰队，此处很适合你。

english: This server is rank-restricted. All players may join to spectate but only players within the specified rank range can play.
chinese: 此服务器有阶级限制。任何玩家都能加入并观战，但只有符合阶级的玩家才能参与对战。

english: Your access to multiplayer has been blocked for reported violations of Steam Community Guidelines and/or NEBULOUS Multiplayer Community Guidelines.  You can still access singleplayer games.  You may appeal your ban via the ModMail bot on our official Discord server (link on the main screen).
chinese: 你违反了 Steam 社区守则与/或本游戏的多人社区守则，因此无法进入多人模式，但依然能游玩单人模式。若需要，可透过官方 Discord 服务器（主画面链结）的 ModMail 机器人提出申诉。

english: You cannot join a game in progress.
chinese: 无法加入进行中的游戏。

english: NOTE: Cost is rounded up to the nearest full point.
chinese: 注意：花费将直接进位至整数。

english: Are you sure you want to remove this missile template from the list of saved templates?  Doing so will not remove instances of this missile from any existing fleets.  This cannot be undone.
chinese: 确定要从已保存模板列表移除该导弹模板？这并不会移除现存于其他舰队中的该导弹实体。此操作无法復原。

english: Design is Invalid - An Avionics Package Is Required
chinese: 设计无效 - 需要航电套组

english: The salvo size threat matrix allows you to define the specific number of interceptor missiles which will be fired at a given threat, based on its type and size.  Each row in the matrix is a threat type, such as conventional missiles, and each column is a threat size ranging from 1 to 3.
chinese: 齐射规模威胁矩阵可让玩家根据威胁类型、尺寸决定要发射的拦截弹数量。矩阵中的 "列" 代表威胁类型（如普通导弹），"行" 代表威胁尺寸（大小从 1 到 3）

english:
Sets the order of priority for threats based on distance.

NEAR-TO-FAR: The closest threats will be targeted before working out to farther ones.
FAR-TO-NEAR: The farthest threats will be targeted before working in to nearer ones.
chinese:
依距离设置威胁选择顺序的优先度。

近至远：优先应对最近威胁后才攻击较远目标。
远至近：优先应对最远威胁后才攻击较近目标。

english: Toggles the complexity of the missile defensive doctrine settings.  In UNIFORM mode all threats will use the same rules for salvo size, priority, etc, regardless of threat size.  In MATRIX mode you can select a specific salvo size for each threat type and size.
chinese: 切换点防御导弹规则设置的复杂度。若设为 "统一" 模式，将无视威胁尺寸，齐射规模、优先度等指标皆套用相同逻辑。若设为 "矩阵" 模式，则可针对每种威胁类型与尺寸选择特定齐射规模。

english: Sets the number of weapons that will be fired at a threat when PDMSL is set to defer to DOCTRINE.  This can be overridden in battle.
chinese: 点防御导弹被设为遵循规则时，对威胁开火的武器数量。此操作可于战斗中强制介入。

english:
Sets the order of priority for target selection.

ASCEND: This missile will be fired at the smallest threats first (from the set selected above) before moving to larger targets.
DESCEND: This missile will be fired at the largest threats first.
chinese:
设置目标选择顺序的优先度。

小到大：此导弹将优先攻击尺寸最小的目标（根据上方选择的组合），接着才攻击大型目标。
大到小：此导弹将优先攻击尺寸最大的目标。

english: Sets the types of threats this missile will be fired against, classified by missile size.  These settings govern how interceptors will be fired when PDMSL is set to DCTRN.  Interceptors will be fired at all targets, regardless of these settings, when PDMSL is set to ALL.
chinese: 依据导弹尺寸设置此导弹要攻击的威胁类型。此设置控制点防御导弹​​设置为 "规则" 时的攻击方式。点防御导弹设置为 "全部" 时，将无视​​设置向所有目标发射拦截弹。

english: Sets the type of threats this missile will be fired against, discriminating between Conventional (standard missiles like the SGM-2) and Hybrid missiles which have a sprint stage (like the SGM-H-3).
chinese: 设置此导弹要攻击的威胁类型，共有普通导弹（如标准型 SGM-2）、混合导弹（如具冲刺能力的 SGM-H-3）两种类型。

english:
Sets the initial launch behavior of the missile.

HOT: The missile's engine will ignite immediately, good for getting the missile moving quickly when fired in range of enemy point defenses.
COLD: The missile will maneuver around the launching ship with thrusters until it has an unobstructed line to the target or first waypoint before igniting the main engine.
chinese:
设置导弹的初始发射行为。

热发射：导弹主引擎将立即点火，适用在处于敌人点防御射程内时快速攻击。
冷发射：导弹会使用推进器移动至可瞄准目标的空旷地带或第一个航点，接着再点燃主引擎。

english:
Sets what the missile will do if the target it has acquired is lost.

RESUME SEARCH: The missile will begin searching for a new target.
SELF DESTRUCT: The missile will self destruct.
chinese:
设置导弹丢失目标时的行为。

持续搜索：导弹将自动搜寻下一个目标。
自毁：导弹将自毁。

english:
Sets the purpose of this missile. 

DEFENSIVE: Missiles can still be manually fired at targets, but they will also be managed by the Point Defense Controller and will automatically be fired at approaching missile threats.
OFFENSIVE: Missiles are only manually fired against designated targets.
chinese:
设置此导弹的用途。

防御：导弹依然能手动发射，但会由点防御控制器管理，并朝来袭的导弹威胁自动开火。
进攻：导弹只能对已指派目标手动发射。

english:
Sets the type of evasive maneuvers the missile will perform on its terminal approach to the target.

NONE: The missile will fly directly towards the target and make no attempt to evade defensive fire.
WEAVE: The missile will weave from side to side.
CORKSCREW: The missile will spiral in towards the target.
chinese:
设置导弹抵近目标时的回避机动行为。

无：导弹将向目标直冲，不做任何回避机动。
摇摆：导弹将侧向来回摇摆。
回旋：导弹将以回旋前进抵近目标。

english:
Controls the approach angle the guidance system will try to maintain.

FREE APPROACH: The missile will fly directly towards the target, wherever it is, with no consideration for the attack geometry.
MINIMUM ANGLE: The guidance system will try to minimize the angle between the missile's position and the line between its launching ship and the target.  This usually results in a head-on approach for hostile missiles.
chinese:
控制导引系统维持的接近角度。

自由角度：不论位置，导弹都将直奔目标，完全不考量攻角几何。
最小角度：导引系统会将导弹与直线（发射舰与目标相连）之间的角度维持在最小。若采用此方法，将会从正面拦截敌方导弹。

english: This missile has been modified since it was added from a saved template.  It will be unique to this fleet until it is saved to a new template, overwrites its original template, or is reverted to its original template.
chinese: 此导弹添加自保存模板，已经过修改。在保存至新模板，或是复写、回復至原始模板前，此导弹都会是该舰队特有的。

english: This missile corresponds directly to a saved template.
chinese: 此导弹可直接对应已保存模板。

english: This missile is unique to this fleet.  You can use it in other fleets by saving it as a template.
chinese: 此导弹是该舰队特有的，可保存为模板让其他舰队使用。

english: The entered missile name is already taken by another missile or missile template. Would you like to automatically rename it to {newName}?
chinese: 输入名称已被其他导弹或模板使用。是否要自动重新命名为{newName}？

english: Are you sure you want to remove this missile type from the fleet?  It will be unloaded from all launchers and magazines that contain it.  This cannot be undone.
chinese: 确定要从舰队移除该导弹类型？将会卸除所有发射器与弹舱内的该型导弹。此操作无法復原。

english: Are you sure you want revert all changes made to this missile?
chinese: 确定要回復对此导弹的所有变更？

english:
Sets the purpose this seeker is used for.  Seekers at the forward end of the missile have priority, and the highest priority seeker must always be set to TARGETING.

TARGETING: This seeker is used to acquire targets.  Seekers set to this mode that are not the Primary targeting seeker will be used as fallbacks if the primary seeker does not find a target.
VALIDATION: If the primary targeting seeker acquires a target, this seeker will be used to check the validity of the target.  This can be used for decoy discrimination.
chinese:
设置此寻标器的用途。导弹最前端的寻标器优先度较高，优先度最高的寻标器必须用于锁定。

锁定：此寻标器用于寻获目标。使用此模式但非主要目获手段的寻标器，将作为主寻标器未寻获目标时的备援。
验证：若主寻标器寻获目标，此寻标器则会用于验证目标，可帮助区别诱饵。

english:
Sets the type of signal this seeker will home in on.

ALL EMISSIONS: This seeker will home in on any emissions in ranges used for radar, including search radars, fire control radars, and jamming signals.
JAMMING: This seeker will only home in on radar jamming signals.
PULSED RADAR: This seeker will only home in on radar emissions from sensors.  It will not seek jamming signals but can still be jammed.
chinese:
设置寻标器归向的讯号类型。

所有电子讯号：此寻标器将跟踪范围内的雷达（含搜索、射控）与干扰讯号。
干扰：此寻标器只会跟踪雷达干扰讯号。
脉冲雷达：此寻标器只会跟踪传感器发出的雷达电子讯号，不会跟踪干扰讯号，但依然会被干扰。

english:
Sets a minimum target size for this seeker to detect.  'Small' targets are objects the size of missiles or fighters.

IGNORE: The seeker will filter out these targets, even when no other targets are present, preventing it from being distracted by non-warship targets.
DETECT: The seeker will not filter these targets, useful for building active point defense missiles.
chinese:
设置寻标器侦测的最小目标体积。 "小型" 目标指的是导弹或战斗机大小的目标。

忽略：即便没有其他目标，寻标器也会过滤这些目标，避免被战舰以外的目标吸引。
侦测：寻标器不会过滤这些目标，适用于打造主动点防御导弹。

english: Sets the angle at which submunitions will be released.
chinese: 设置投放次弹药的角度。

english: When set to activate on TARGET DETECTED, determines the maximum range to the target submunitions will be released at.
chinese: 设置为 "侦获目标" 启动时，判定投放次弹药的最大距离。

english:
Sets the conditions which will trigger the release of submunitions.

END OF PATH: Submunitions will be released when this missile reaches the end of its cruise path or when it runs out of fuel.
TARGET DETECTED: Submunitions will be fired in the direction of the detected target.
chinese:
设置投放次弹药的条件。 

路径终点：导弹抵达路径终点或燃料耗尽时，次弹药将被释出。 
侦获目标：朝已侦获目标方向发射次弹药。

english: Threat Size 1 Includes small, fast missiles like the SGM-100 Balestra, as well as light and/or utility spacecraft.
chinese: 威胁尺寸 1 包含小型目标、高速导弹（如 SGM-100 十字弓），以及轻型/多用途战机。

english: Threat Size 3 Includes heavy missiles and torpedos like the SGT-300 Pilum, as well as heavy anti-ship bomber spacecraft.
chinese: 威胁尺寸 3 包含重型导弹、鱼雷（如 SGT-300 重标枪）、重型反舰轰炸机。

english: Threat Size 2 Includes general purpose anti-ship missiles like the SGM-200 Tempest, as well as medium-sized fighter spacecraft.
chinese: 威胁尺寸 2 包含通用反舰导弹（如 SGM-200 暴风雨）、中型战机。

english:
Sets the behavior of this seeker when there are no validated targets present.

ACCEPT: If there are no targets present that a validating seeker has tagged as valid, this seeker will still pursue one of the available unvalidated targets.
REJECT: This seeker will only pursue targets affirmatively tagged as valid by a validating seeker, and will ignore unvalidated targets even if no valid targets are present.
chinese:
设置无已验证目标时的寻标器行为。

接受：若没有被验证寻标器证明为有效的目标，此寻标器依然会跟踪其中一个未验证目标。
拒绝：此寻标器只会跟踪验证寻标器证明为有效的目标，即使无有效目标，也会忽略未验证目标。

english: Are you sure you want to update the original template file for the missile {designName}?  This will not update instances of this missile in other fleets.
chinese: 确定要更新{designName}导弹的原始模板？将不会更新其他舰队中该导弹的实体。

english: The missile {missileName} has a warhead intended to destroy missiles/craft but it is set to Offensive use. This missile will not be used for defensive purposes without enabling Defensive doctrine.
chinese: {missileName}导弹搭载了针对导弹/战机的弹头，但被用于进攻。若未启动防御规则，此导弹将不会用于防御。

english: The missile {missileName} has Defensive doctrine enabled but one or more of its seekers are not configured to detect small targets.
chinese: {missileName}导弹採用防御规则，但有一个或多个寻标器并未针对小型目标做设置。
可能的寻标器设置错误

english: The missile {missileName} has seekers which are similar and provide little or no additional redundancy or benefit.
chinese: {missileName}导弹搭载重複/相似的寻标器，无法提供冗余或助益。

english: The missile {missileName} has validators which provide no benefit to the primary targeting seeker(s).
chinese: {missileName}导弹搭载的验证器无法为主寻标器提供助益。

english: NEBULOUS: Fleet Command Multiplayer Community Guidelines and Standards. Online multiplayer, particularly in competitive games, is an inherently unpredictable environment. We at Eridanus Industries want the multiplayer experience for all of our players to be fun, enjoyable, and free from harassment and bigotry. To that end, we lay out the following guidelines to keep our community a positive place for all to enjoy. 1. Agreement to Terms By clicking the Accept button below and proceeding to the multiplayer match browser, you explicitly agree to be bound by the terms below while interacting with other players through our game. Any substantive updates to these community guidelines will be brought to your attention through the resurfacing of this prompt. 2. Moderation Policy As a small team, Eridanus Industries does not actively moderate NEBULOUS multiplayer matches, as the majority of games are hosted on individual players' PCs or private servers. However, we reserve the right to revoke the multiplayer privileges (e.g. ban) any player who is reported to us, including for offenses reported or committed before these standards were implemented. Concerned players can make reports about in-game behavior via the "Report Player" feature or to our official Discord moderators via the ModMail bot. 3. Community Guidelines When playing online multiplayer games in NEBULOUS, players are responsible for their own actions. We ask that you treat other players with respect at all times, and refrain from any objectionable or disruptive behavior, such as: * Harassment * Hate speech or hateful conduct * Threats of violence and harm * Promoting or glorifying suicide or self-harm * Promoting of glorifying violent extremism * Sexual obscenity * Spam and fraud * Impersonation and phishing * Cheating, exploits, bots, hacks, and other abuse We define actions towards other players as any kind of interaction other players may see including, but not limited to: * Chat messages * Usernames/Handles * Fleet Badges * Ship Names * Lobby Titles We may remove multiplayer privileges from players that violate the spirit of these guidelines even if a specific action is not explicitly covered above. 4. Ban Appeal Players who have had their multiplayer privileges revoked via a ban can appeal that ban by contacting a moderator on our offical Discord, using the link in the bottom right corner of the main menu. 5. Data Retention & Privacy Players reported for poor multiplayer conduct via the in-game reporting tool will have their 64-bit Steam ID retained in an official repository along with all chat messages sent in the presence of the reporting player, all ship names in their current fleet, an encoding of their fleet badge image, and other information. This data is collected for the purpose of moderator review and is retained for at least 30 days and possibly up to 60 days. This data is only stored for players that have had conduct reports filed against them. Additionally, banned players have their Steam ID permanently retained in our ban database. Eridanus Industries will NEVER share this information with any outside entity. All collected data is necessary for multiplayer community moderation and cannot be opted out of if you wish to participate in multiplayer. 6. Release of Liability By proceeding to multiplayer you acknowledge that, while we will attempt to deal with disruptive players to the best of our ability, Eridanus Industries is not liable for the conduct of players and any negative results deriving from that behavior. Thank you, and we'll see you in the Battlespace.
chinese: 《星云：战舰指挥官》 多人模式社区守则与规范。 在竞技类游戏中，线上多人模式的游戏环境往往是无法预测的。 Eridanus Industries 开发团队的所有人希望每位玩家都能拥有美好、零骚扰的游戏体验，因此我们制定了以下守则维护社区的秩序。 1.我同意以下守则 进入对战浏览器前请点击下方的 "接受"，代表你愿意在与其他玩家互动时遵循守则。若我们变更了社区守则内容，此提示将重新显示以提醒玩家。 2.管理政策 Eridanus Industries 身为小型团队，我们不会主动监控每一场对战，而且对战是由个别玩家的电脑或私人伺服器所主持。然而，我们保有撤销（停权）遭检举玩家游玩多人模式的权力，并溯及至此守则发布前就已遭回报与犯下恶意行为的玩家。玩家可在游戏内使用 "举报玩家" 功能回报不当行为，也能透过 ModMail 机器人向官方 Discord 管理员回报。 3.社区守则 游玩线上多人模式时，所有玩家皆必须对自身言行负起责任。我们要求每位玩家都能互相尊重，并避免任何令人反感或干扰他人的行为，包括： *骚扰 *仇恨性言论与行为 *暴力威胁与伤害 *宣扬或美化自杀/自伤行为 *宣扬或美化极端暴力行为 *性猥亵行为 *垃圾邮件与诈欺行为 *冒充与钓鱼行为 *作弊、钻漏洞、机器人、骇入与其他滥用行为 我们将对其他玩家进行的互动定义为 "其他玩家可能看到的任何类型互动"，其包括但不限于 *聊天讯息 *使用者名称/昵称 *舰队徽章 *舰船名称 *大厅名称 即使特定行为并未涵盖于上述内容，只要触犯上述规范精神，我们依然会撤销该玩家的游戏权利。 4.停权申诉 多人游戏模式遭停权的玩家拥有申诉的权利，使用主选单右下角的连结联络官方 Discord 管理员即可。 5.数据保留&隐私政策 对于多人模式中因不当行为遭游戏内工具舉報的玩家，其 64 位元 Steam ID、完整聊天纪录、目前舰队中的所有舰船名称、舰队徽章编码等各项其他信息将被留存于官方的数据库中。上述数据将用于管理员审核，至少留存 30 天，最多 60 天。我们仅会保存遭到舉報的玩家数据，此外，遭停权玩家的 Steam ID 将永久留存于停权数据库中。 Eridanus Industries 绝不会与外部第三方分享这些数据。搜集数据是管理多人游戏社区的必要手段，若要游玩多人模式，就必须同意上述规范。 6.免责声明 进入多人游戏模式代表你已清楚认知，Eridanus Industries 将尽最大能力处理玩家的不当行为，我们不会对玩家的行为与该行为导致的后果承担任何责任。 感谢各位阅读至此，我们战斗空间见。

english:
This system can be used to report player conduct that violates the NEBULOUS community standards.  You may only submit 2 reports per day.

Select a report category from the dropdown.  These demerits will be entered into the player's service record.  Players with enough demerits will be highlighted to all other players in their lobby.  The report will automatically include the player's name, badge, fleet prefix, and a log of all chat messages they sent.  Additionally, if the report was submitted after a game, a list of all ship and missile names will be included.
chinese:
此系统可举报报违反游戏社区规范的玩家，一天仅能举报 2 次。

请在下拉选单中选择回报类型。该玩家的不良行为将被登载于服役纪录中。若不良纪录过多，该玩家进入大厅时将被註记。回报内容包含玩家名称、徽章、舰队前缀以及所有聊天讯息的记录档。此外，若是于游戏结束后送出，列表中将包含所有舰船与导弹的名称。

english: Ships which are owned by the player's faction will always show up in the list of ships available in the player's fleet for a quick test setup.  Check this box to add non-player-faction ships (e.g. a ship the player will have transferred to them via scripted event) to the list of ships that can be selected when starting a test.
chinese: 属于玩家阵营的舰船会始终显示在可用舰船列表中，方便玩家进行快速测试。勾选此框可将非玩家阵营舰船 (例如，玩家从脚本事件获得的舰船) 加入列表，并用于测试。

english: By default ship voices are randomly selected at game start.  Select a voice in this dropdown to force this ship to always use that voice.
chinese: 默认状态下，舰船语音会在开始游戏时随机选择。在此下拉选单中进行选择，即可强制该舰船始终使用该语音。

chinese: 确认要删除此轨道？此操作无法复原。

chinese: 确认要删除此过场动画？此操作无法复原。

chinese: 为新过场动画输入名称。

chinese: 输入大型主要文字内容 ({appearance})

english: If you have a ship with an extremely high point cost, like a fleet carrier, many AI ships may not engage it until there are no other targets available because they try to match themselves to targets roughly equivalent to their own point cost.  Set a point cost here to override what the AI will view the ship's point cost as when determining targets.  Set to <= 0 to use normal point cost calculations.
chinese: 若某艘船的点数花费极高（如航母），多数 AI 舰船会优先攻击其他与自身点数相当的对手，等没有目标时才会攻击该高点数目标。设置点数花费可覆盖 AI 以点数选择对手的逻辑。设为<= 0以使用一般点数计算方式。

 ESC 键取消。

english: Disabling this option will prevent nameplate textures from being baked for ships, significantly reducing required texture memory for low-end computers or very large games.
chinese: 关闭此功能则不会将铭牌纹理写入舰体，可大幅减少低阶电脑或大型游戏占用的纹理记忆体。

chinese: 下载战斗报告中 - 请勿离开 - {progress}

chinese: 已收到战斗报告 - 随时可离开

chinese: 传输战斗报告中 - 请勿离开 - {progress}

english: Open the local star system map
Open the TACON Assignments Table, allowing you to transfer control of ships between commanders.
chinese: 在战术管制指派表中，玩家能将舰船控制权移交给指挥官。

english: Attack Target Defines the type of modules on an enemy target this Flight will attemp to target. Note that this selection does not apply to some weapons such as autonomous missiles.
chinese: 攻击目标 选择要攻击的敌方模组类型。注意，部分武器不适用此选项（如自主运行的导弹）。

english: Combat Coherence Defines whether this Flight will hold formation and engage a single target or break formation to engage multiple nearby targets when given an attack order.
chinese: 战斗连贯性 下达攻击命令时，维持当下编队攻击单一目标，或是分散行动追击多个目标。

english: Countermeasure Usage Controls when craft will deploy countermeasures when threatened by an enemy missile. AUTO will deploy countermeasures depending on the type of the incoming threat, ALL will always deploy countermeasures when evading, and NEVER will never deploy. To trigger manual trigger deployment use in conjunction with the DEFND setting.
chinese: 反制措施使用 选择战机遭遇敌方导弹威胁时部署反制的时机。设为 "自动" 时，将根据威胁类型部署反制措施；设为 "全部" 时，会在回避时部署反制措施；设为 "从不" 时，则不会部署反制措施。 若要启用手动触发部署，请与 "防御" 设置一同使用。

english: Missile Self-Defense Controls when craft will go evasive to defend themselves from enemy missiles. AUTO will trigger automatically when under threat. When set to MAN, evasion will only trigger when Left Shift + Z is pressed for all craft currently under threat as well as all craft which come under threat in the next 30 seconds. Craft will always weave and evade when under close-range gunfire from other craft, regardless of this setting.
chinese: 导弹自我防禦 控制战机遭遇敌方导弹时的回避时机。 "自动" 模式遭遇威胁将自动触发。设为 "手动" 时，必须按下左 Shift + Z，所有已受威胁以及后续 30 秒内将受威胁的战机才会执行回避动作。 无论设置为何，遭遇近距离机炮攻击时，战机将以摇摆机动回避。

english: Missile Self-Defense Tactics Controls which defensive tactics craft will use when threatened by an enemy missile. Countermeasure deployment is used in accordance with the CMSR setting for all tactics. AUTO: Craft will determine their evasion tactics based on the configuration of the enemy missile. NOTCH: Craft will perform a dogleg maneuver ending in flying perpendicular to the threat. SCRAM: Craft will fly directly away from the threat. OUT-G: Craft will turn hard perpendicular to the threat at the last moment to attempt to exceed its turning capability. Craft will always weave and evade when under close-range gunfire from other craft, regardless of this setting.
chinese: 导弹防禦战术 选择战机遭遇敌方导弹威胁时的防禦战术。所有战术反制措施的部署方式均依照 "反制" 设置进行。 自动：战机将根据敌方导弹设置决定回避战术。 侧向：战机将执行狗腿机动，使自身方向与目标方向垂直。 飞离：战机将直接飞离威胁。 超 G：战机会在最后一刻急转弯使自身与目标方向垂直，使目标转弯不及。 无论设置为何，遭遇近距离机炮攻击时，战机将以摇摆机动回避。

english: Formation Type Defines the formation this Flight will take. Options are Wedge, Line, Cross, and Echelon.
chinese: 编队类型 定义此次飞行的编队模式，共有楔形、线形、十字、梯队四种。

english: Engine Hard Burn Turns on engine boost for this Flight, greatly increasing their speed but increasing fuel consumption even more.
chinese: 引擎加力推进 飞行时开启加力推进，可大幅提升速度，但燃料消耗也会增加。

english: Maneuvering Posture Determines the directness of the route to the next waypoint. Evasive flight settings will make random course changes to attempt to avoid incoming fire.
chinese: 机动姿态 决定前往下一个航点的方式。迴避飞行模式将随机变更航线躲避敌火。

english: Radar Emissions Control Controls the radiating state of the sensors of all craft in this group, making them harder to detect but also leaving them reliant on other units for tracks or on their own visual targeting.
chinese: 雷达射频控制 控制机队内所有发射器的发射状态，可降低被侦测风险，但需仰赖其他单位进行侦测，或以目视跟踪。

english: Attack Range When set to Stand In craft will approach to within at least 4km of the target before firing any weapons, regardless of their true max range, and lob missiles from that range. In Stand Off mode craft will launch weapons immediately when given an attack order for a target in range. In Gun mode the craft will always close to gun range and dogfight.
chinese: 攻击范围 设为 "距内" 时，战机将无视最大射程，抵近至距离目标 4 公里内才发射武器，并以抛射弹道发射导弹。设为 "距外" 时，只要目标位于射程，收到攻击命令便会直接攻击。设为 "机炮" 时，战机会抵近至机炮射程内进行缠斗。

english: Missile/Bomb Salvo Size Defines how many guided missiles or bombs this craft will allow to be in flight in a single salvo against a given target. Setting to UNLIM will continue to fire missiles until the target is lost/destroyed or all racks are empty. NOTE: This does not apply to command-guided missiles, unless the spaceframe is capable of controlling multiple at a time (e.g. Bombers).
chinese: 导弹/炸弹齐射规模 决定战机单次对目标齐射的导弹或炸弹数量。设为 "无限" 时，将连续发射导弹或清空挂架上的武器，直到失去/摧毁目标。 注意：除非该机体（如轰炸机）能够导引多个弹药，否则不适用指令导引导弹。

english: Stance Defines how aggressive this flight will be when near an enemy unit. Aggressive will pursue all enemy units in range. Evasive will flee from all nearby enemies. Passive will take no action.
chinese: 姿态 定义机舰靠近敌人单位时的行为模式。 "进攻" 将追击范围内所有敌人。 "回避" 将逃离附近敌人。 "被动" 则不会採取行动。

english: Detach the selected craft into a new Flight.
chinese: 分离所选战机至新的飞行架次。

english: Begin immediately returning to the ship that launched this flight.  This issues a soft RTB order, which can be overridden by issuing another order to this flight.
chinese: 立刻返回起飞舰船。此为非强制返航命令，能以其他命令覆盖。

english: Return To Base, by Weapon Status Defines when this flight will return to base automatically based on the remaining weapon load. WINCH will return when all members are completely empty on all weapons. SKOSH will return when all standoff weapons such as missiles have been expended, even if gun ammo remains.
chinese: 依武器状态返回基地 根据剩余武器弹药自动定义返回基地的时机。设为 "无弹药" 时，只有弹药完全耗尽才会返航。设为 "挂载耗尽" 时，即便机炮仍有弹药，所有距外武器（如导弹）耗尽后依然会返航。

english:
<color=#FF2525>Order Evacuation</color>
This will cause the crew to abandon ship.  Once an evacuation is ordered, it cannot be countermanded.

<color=#FF2525>This order will render the ship unrecoverable via salvage.</color>
chinese:
<color=#FF2525>下令撤离</color>
船员将弃船逃离。撤离命令一旦下达就无法撤销。 

<color=#FF2525>此命令会使后续人员无法藉由打捞回收该舰船。 </color>

english: Emergency Reactor Shutdown Initiates an emergency shutdown on all reactors and drives. Your crew will take 30 seconds to complete the shutdown procedure, after which time all reactor overload events will be cleared. All powerplant modules which were in the process of overloading when the shutdown was completed will require a restore to bring back online. It will take an additional 30 seconds to bring the remaining systems back online. Once a shutdown is ordered it cannot be countermanded.
chinese: 反应堆紧急停机 紧急关闭所有反应堆与驱动系统。船员需要 30 秒完成关机程序，完成后将消除所有反应堆超载状态。所有关机时处于超载的发电模组需先修復才能重新使用，而且需要再花费 30 秒重新启动系统。停机命令一旦下达就无法撤销。

english: All groups and ships must be assigned a deployment position.
chinese: 所有船团与舰船必须被指派到部署位置。

english: This station berth does not have the ability to repair the docked ship's armor and internal structure.
chinese: 此站点泊位无法维修停靠舰船的装甲及内部结构。

english: Station services are unavailable until all controlling stations have been captured.
chinese: 占领所有控制站前无法使用站点功能。

english: This station berth does not have the ability to repair the docked ship's components.
chinese: 此站点泊位无法维修停靠舰船的零件。

english: This station berth has the ability to repair the docked ship's components up to {repAmount}.  The bonus repair rate is {repRate}. Open the Damage Control Board to prioritize repairs.
chinese: 此站点泊位可维修停靠舰船的零件，最高可达 {repAmount}。额外维修率为 {repRate}。可开启损害管制面板排定维修顺序。

english: This ship configuration does not contain any munitions to be looted.
chinese: 此艘舰船没有可搜括的弹药。

english: This item type is not used by any component or craft that can access this container.
chinese: 可存取该容器的零件或战机并未使用此物件类型。

english: This ship cannot be salvaged.  Critical systems were destroyed beyond possibility of repair by the crew during a manually-ordered evacuation to frustrate enemy recovery efforts.
chinese: 无法打捞此舰船。船员在撤离前已彻底破坏重要系统，防止敌人回收可用资源。

english: This ship can be salvaged by the docked unit(s).  The salvage process will consume {count} restore(s) to repair {components}, allowing the ship to be moved elsewhere for more intensive repairs.
chinese: 可被单位停靠并回收可用资源。打捞时将花费{count}个修复次数维修{components}，让该舰船能移动至其他地点进行深入维修。

chinese: 命令此舰船的所有已升空战机立刻返回基地。

Indicates Deck Status:
RED - No spacecraft currently launching or landing, free maneuver permitted.
AMBER - Spacecraft are on pads waiting to launch, but ship is not within maneuvering envelope.
GREEN - Spacecraft able to launch and land.  Ship is travelling at < 15m/s and is facing with 7.5 degrees of its velocity vector.

Click to toggle holding deck at AMBER status when craft are ready for launch, preventing them from taking off.
chinese:
显示甲板状态：
红 - 目前无战机起降，可自由机动。 
黄 - 战机正于平台等待起飞，但舰船未处于机动包络线。 
绿 - 战机可起降。舰船正以速度 < 15米/秒且速度向量为 7.5 度行进。 

点击将甲板切换并维持于 "黄色" 灯号，避免战机起飞。

english: Click to assign this mission profile to ALL selected craft.
chinese: 点击将任务配置指派给所有已选战机。

english: Click to assign this mission profile to this craft only.
chinese: 点击将任务配置限定指派给该战机。

english: One unit of fuel is needed for this ship to traverse between two locations on the map.  Without fuel, the ship can't travel and will be abandoned when crossing the withdraw line.
chinese: 舰船需要一单位燃料才能在地图上的两个地点之间航行。若缺少燃料，舰船就无法行动，并且会在跨越撤退线时被抛弃。

chinese:
战斗尚未结束，你的队伍仍在奋战。现在离开将导致其他玩家被迫退出游戏。

<b>你无法获得任何经验值。
对航迹目标发射{totalTargets}枚{missileName}导弹

english: {name} is out of bounds and will return in {time} seconds

english: Cooperative Defensive Fire If enabled, this ship will coordinate with nearby friendly ships when firing interceptor missiles to reduce waste. ALL will coordinate defensive fire for all nearby friendly ships. OTHER will coordinate defensive fire to protect other friendly ships, but will also fire to defend itself even if other ships are firing. NONE will fire missiles at all threats if possible, even if other ships are firing. Cooperative Defense requires COMMS to be enabled.
chinese: 联合防御火力 若启用，此舰船将与附近的友方舰船共同发射拦截弹，减少弹药浪费。 "全部" 将会协调并使用附近所有友军的防御火力。 "其他" 将会协调并使用防御火力保护其他友军，即便其他舰船正在开火，也会开火进行自卫。 "无" 将会尽可能向所有威胁发射导弹，即便其他舰船正在开火。 需开启 "通讯" 才能使用联合防御功能。

english: Firing Mode Controls the firing of interceptor missiles. In DCTRN mode, missiles will be fired according to their programmed doctrine. When set to ALL, they will be fired indiscriminantly at the nearest threats, and in MAN they will only be fired at prioritized targets.
chinese: 火力模式 控制拦截导弹。设为 "规则" 时，导弹将依照设置的规则攻击目标；设为 "全部" 时，导弹会无差别攻击最近的威胁；设为 "手动" 时，导弹只会攻击优先目标。

english: Firing Policy Controls the maximum number of salvos that will be fired at a target, not including Last Salvo (if enabled). MAX DOF will continue to fire successive salvos after the previous salvo's India time until the target is destroyed.
chinese: 火力策略 控制齐射的最大次数，不包含 "最终齐射"（若启用）。「最大深度火力" 将于间隔时间后接续齐射，直到目标摧毁。

english: Last Salvo If enabled, another salvo of missiles will be fired at the last possible moment, even if other missiles are already in flight to that target.
chinese: 最终齐射 若启用，即便导弹已发射，依然会在最后一刻进行另一次导弹齐射。

english: Craft No Escape Zone If enabled this ship will only fire missiles at small craft (fighter, bomber, etc) when they have been determined to be in the missile's NEZ. If the target were to turn away at max speed the missile would still reach it.
chinese: 战机不可逃逸区 若启用，此舰船只会攻击进入导弹不可逃逸区的小型机舰（战机、轰炸机等）。即便目标以最高速度调头离去，导弹依然能追击。

english: Salvo Size Controls the number of interceptor missiles that will be fired at a threat in a single salvo.
chinese: 齐射规模 控制单次齐射打出的导弹数量。

english: Battle-Short Overrides equipment safeties to allow them to operate indefinitely. WARNING: Modules operating in battle override mode will receive periodic damage when operating outside their safe limits.
chinese: 战斗超载 关闭设备的安全机制，使其无限运作。 警告：模块在战斗中超限运作将使其定期受到伤害。

english: Communications Emissions Control Controls the radiating state of the ship's communications suite. Disabling transmission will reduce signature, making this ship harder to detect. It will still be able to receive the common sensor picture from friendly ships, but cannot contribute to it.
chinese: 通讯发射控制 控制舰船感通讯系统的发射状态。停用通讯能减少自身讯迹，降低被侦测风险。此时只能被动接收友军传感器的情资。

english: Point Defenses - Decoys Controls the automatic or manual tasking of electronic warfare decoys. When set to LEAST, only the lowest-capability decoy necessary to defeat a given threat will be deployed. When set to BEST, the highest-capability decoy will be used for a given threat, even if a lower-capability one could have been used. When set to AUTO all decoys which are compatible with the threat will be fired.
chinese: 点防御 - 诱饵 控制手动或自动释放电子战诱饵。 设为 "最低" 时，仅会释放能击败威胁的低阶诱饵。设为 "最高" 时，将释出能击败威胁的高阶诱饵，也可能释出低阶诱饵。设为「自动" 时，将发射所有与威胁类型对应的诱饵。

english: Electronic Support Modules Controls the activity of passive electronic support modules. Does not reduce signature, but can be toggled to reduce clutter once a sensor track has been acquired on a signal.
chinese: 电子支援模块 控制被动电子支援模块的活动。无法降低讯迹。在传感器收到讯号时，可用于减少杂讯。

english: Formation Positioning Defines how all ships in the current formation take position relative to the guide. True positioning will keep the same true bearings regardless of the direction the guide is facing. Relative positioning will reposition escorts when the guide turns. Setting this applies to all ships in the same formation. In Loose mode the guide will not slow down to let lagging escorts catch up.
chinese: 编队定位 定义编队中的舰船与领队的相对位 "真实定位" 可确保领队不论朝向何方，舰船之间都能保持在相同方位线上。 "相对定位" 会在领队转弯时变换护卫的位置。此设置将套用至同一编队中的所有舰船。使用 "分散模式" 时，领队将不会减速等待落后的护航舰船。

english: Maneuvering Posture Determines the directness of the route to the next waypoint. Evasive flight settings will make random course changes to attempt to avoid incoming fire.
chinese: 机动姿态 决定前往下一个航点的方式。回避飞行模式将随机变更航线躲避敌火。

english: Point Defenses - Missiles Controls the firing of interceptor missiles. Click to open policy settings.
chinese: 点防御 - 导弹 控制拦截导弹。点击可开启规则设置。

english: Point Defenses - Turrets Controls the automatic or manual tasking of point defense turrets. When in MAN, turrets will only shoot at designated point defense priorities. When in DEDI, only dedicated point defense turrets will be used and dual-purpose weapons will be left idle.
chinese: 点防御 - 炮塔 选择自动或手动控制点防御炮塔。设为 "手动" 时，炮塔只会攻击优先指定目标。设为 "指定" 时，只有被指定的炮塔会攻击，双用途武器则维持闲置。

english: Point Defense Zone Controls where this warship's defenses will be targeted. AREA mode will target all missiles in range, prioritzing missiles targeting this ship but also defending nearby friendly ships. POINT mode will only target missiles directly threatening this ship.
chinese: 点防御区域 控制舰船的防御方向。设为 "区域" 时，将标定所有范围内的导弹并优先应对锁定自身的导弹，同时保护友军。设为 "点" 时，仅会应对锁定自身的导弹。

english: Radar Emissions Control Controls the radiating state of the ship's sensor suite. All sensors operate under the same uniform condition. Disabling sensors will cause this ship to become reliant on the sensors of other ships in the fleet, but will reduce its overall signature making it more difficult to detect.
chinese: 雷达发射控制 控制舰船传感器的发射状态。所有传感器皆于相同状况下运作。停用传感器会变得需仰赖其他舰船进行侦测，但能减少自身讯迹，降低被侦测风险。
伤害：{damageCount:000} 队伍：{teamCount} 恢復：{restoreCount}

english: Throttle Control Sets both the max speed and thruster power for the ship. WARNING: Prolonged use of FLANK speed will cause damage to engines; reserve for emergency use.
chinese: 动力控制 设置舰船的极速与推进器功率。 警告：使用 "战速" 过久会损坏引擎，请留待紧急情况时使用。

english: Weapons Control Controls the ability to release weapons. Set to HOLD to be able to issue this ship targeting orders without actually firing. Weapons will bear on target but only fire when set to TIGHT or FREE. When set to FREE ships will automatically return fire with non-missile weapons on targets that are firing at them.
chinese: 武器控制 控制武器使用。设为 "停火" 时依然可以下达攻击命令，但不会执行。武器将对准目标，只有设为 "管制" 或 "自由" 时才会开火。设为 "自由" 时，舰船将自动使用导弹以外的武器回击对方。

chinese: 舰队中目前有 {shipCount} 艘舰船燃料量危急：{shipList}。除非重新补给燃料，否则燃料耗尽的舰船抵达当前目的地后将无法离开，只能弃船。

english: Fuel levels for ships can be viewed in the bottom right of the ship information bar when a ship is selected, and fuel levels for the entire fleet can be viewed in the left-hand fleet ship list of the system map.
chinese: 选择舰船后，可在右下角的舰船信息栏查看剩余燃料量，而舰队整体的剩余油量则可在星系图左侧的舰船列表查看。

english: The fleet currently has {shipCount} ship(s) which are at severely low fuel levels: {shipList}. These ships will be able to make one more transit burn after arriving at the current destination.
chinese: 舰队中目前有 {shipCount} 艘舰船燃料量过低：{shipList}。这些舰船抵达当前目的地后只能再进行一次移动。

english: All components on this ship have been repaired to their maximum possible level during the transit.  Allocate restores for destroyed components with Shift + Left Click on the damage control board below.
chinese: 此舰船的所有零件已在航行途中修复至可用最大生命值。在下方的损害管制面板使用 Shift + 左键 为损毁零件分配维修资源。

english: Only specialized ships have the equipment necessary to transfer munitions and supplies while in transit.
chinese: 只有特殊舰船具有可在航行途中输送弹药与补给的设备。

english: Automatically moves ammunition into all magazines of all ships in the fleet to match the default values they started with, depending on available space.  This will NOT remove non-standard ammunition loaded at a later time.
